hostDiscovery.evidence: installed @opencode-ai/sdk v2 Event union (types.gen.d.ts) exposes session.next.tool.called/success/failed and permission.asked/replied — no tool.execute.before/after for TUI plugins (those exist only on the server-plugin Hooks interface, index.d.ts)

implemented.optionA: typed subscriptions: session.next.tool.called / session.next.tool.success / session.next.tool.failed (join existing permission.asked/replied + message/session events), debounced 150ms
implemented.optionC: ONE bounded fs.watch on .opencode/ai/permissions/ filtered to permission-decisions.jsonl — the exact file the tool.execute.before guard appends denies to; covers hard-deny (which emits no permission.ask). Single watcher, debounced via same refresh path, disposed on onDispose, error handler closes watcher (fail-open)

securityRealtime.hardDenyRefreshChain: guard deny → appendFileSync permission-decisions.jsonl → fs.watch event → debounced refresh() → snapshot → vm.security.denies → security panel
securityRealtime.transitionTelemetry: deny-count INCREASE logged as tui-security-state-change (machine-verifiable acceptance)
securityRealtime.negativeControl: unit-proven: allow decisions and permission.updated observations never surface as hard denies (data-driven, not event-driven)
